description: Published vector values that changed between mvp-0.2-baseline.11 and mvp-0.2-baseline.12, each with the decision that approved it. Checked by scripts/check-baseline-changes.mjs; any other changed or removed value fails validation.

changed.from: conflicts[object-id][field] lists the concurrent values of a scalar field, sorted; conflicts[object-id][''] counts concurrent objects under one Object ID (an OBJECT_ID_COLLISION)
changed.to: conflicts[object-id][field] lists the distinct concurrent values of a scalar field, sorted, when there are two or more (equal values agree, §45); conflicts[object-id][''] counts concurrent objects under one Object ID (an OBJECT_ID_COLLISION)
changed.rule: Owner decision (2026-10-13), SHARED-OBJECTS-PROFILE-01 §45: a conflict set is the set of a field's distinct concurrent values, reported only when it holds two or more. The convention says so; no scenario's conflicts change.

Owner decision (2026-10-13), SHARED-OBJECTS-PROFILE-01 §45 and SHARED-SECTIONS-PROFILE-01 §7, §14.3: concurrent equal values of a scalar register agree and are not a conflict. SS86's two concurrent deletions both write lifecycle = deleted, so its scalar conflict deleted/deleted is no longer reported; the entry is removed.
